title: Featurized Occupation Measures for Structured Global Search in Numerical Optimal Control
summary: Numerical optimal control is split between globally structured but dimensionally intractable Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) methods and scalable but local trajectory optimization. We introduce Featurized Occupation Measures (FOM), a finite-dimensional primal--dual interface where HJB subsolutions guide primal search and primal occupation data can inform certificate refinement. Explicit and implicit realizations, based on finite Liouville tests and rollout-sampled residuals, are proved asymptotically consistent with the exact occupation-measure LP.
